subject: Security evidence pack + VM QA: SBOM, SAST/DAST, pen test and patch SLA
messages:
From: Maya Gupta <m.gupta@zephyrus.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VM questionnaire: SBOM / SAST results / patch SLAs needed for validation

Hi Rachel / Evelyn,

Thanks for engaging — Zephyrus is progressing your RFP to the security gate. Our assessment team needs the vulnerability management artifacts listed below to continue:

- Current SBOM for the inference control plane and model-serving runtime (format: CSV or CycloneDX)
- SAST snapshot covering our top-level services (build date + tools used)
- DAST scan summary for the public-facing API endpoints (scope: inference API + auth endpoints)
- Executive summary of the most recent third-party penetration test (high/medium findings + remediation status)
- Patch/patching SLA language (time-to-patch critical/important/medium) and evidence of recent patching cadence

Can you provide these artifacts or point to a secure share by end of week? Also let us know if any items require an NDA or redaction. I can open a secure intake ticket if needed.

We are attempting to meet our internal security committee cutoff on 2025-08-28.

Appreciate a short note on timelines — if you can provide primary artifacts now and follow-up docs later that’s fine.

Best,
Maya Gupta
Lead Security Analyst, Zephyrus Financial
security-requests@zephyrus.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Maya Gupta <m.gupta@zephyrus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VM questionnaire: SBOM / SAST results / patch SLAs needed for validation

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide everything requested and can split deliverables into an immediate package and a follow-up with deeper artifacts. Attached is our current exported SBOM and a recent SAST snapshot for the runtime and control plane.

What I'm attaching now (initial package):
- redwood_sbom_20250731.csv (SBOM export, CycloneDX-style columns)
- sast_snapshot_20250715.txt (toolchain: semgrep + internal static analyzer; includes rule counts and top findings)

We'll supply the DAST executive summary and the third-party pen test executive summary tomorrow once I consolidate with Karthik and Marcus. Also including a draft patch SLA for your review — we'll confirm final wording and provide evidence (ticketing exports) in the next email.

If you need a specific format (CycloneDX JSON, SPDX), call that out and we'll convert. For anything classified, say so and we'll route through the secure share.

Next steps:
- I will send pen test exec summary + patch SLA draft by 2025-08-17 EOD.
- Offer: 60-minute technical Q&A with our security engineering team (Karthik + Marcus) — suggest Tue 2025-08-19 morning PT if that works.

Attachments (initial): redwood_sbom_20250731.csv (CSV), sast_snapshot_20250715.txt (TXT)

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-08-16T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: VM questionnaire: SBOM / SAST results / patch SLAs needed for validation

Internal — forwarding Zephyrus request. They need DAST exec summary, pentest exec summary, and formalized patch SLA language. I attached the SBOM + SAST we just sent. Marcus / Karthik, can you:

- Confirm the latest third-party pentest summary (redacted) we can share and which findings have been remediated vs in-progress.
- Draft explicit SLA text for critical/important/medium patches (we generally commit to 7 days for critical with mitigations; need a short paragraph we can include in the RFP packet).
- Provide any ticket export or time-to-patch evidence we can include as supporting artifacts (anonymized).

Zephyrus cutoff: security committee 2025-08-28. I'd like to send a consolidated packet by EOD 2025-08-17.

Thanks — Rachel

> Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide everything requested...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: VM questionnaire: SBOM / SAST results / patch SLAs needed for validation

Rachel / Marcus — attaching the executive summary of the most recent third-party penetration test (we've redacted customer-identifying details and test tool output). I've also drafted a short patch SLA paragraph (see below) that aligns with our operational telemetry. Please review and let me know if you want tighter commitments or additional supporting evidence.

Attachment: pentest_exec_summary_20250630.pdf (PDF, redacted)
Attachment: patch_sla_draft_20250816.docx (DOCX)

Draft patch SLA paragraph (suggested):
"Redwood Inference maintains a prioritized vulnerability remediation process. Critical vulnerabilities (CVSS >= 9.0 or exploitable remote code execution) are acknowledged within 4 hours of detection and mitigation/patch or approved compensating controls are deployed within 7 calendar days. High/Important vulnerabilities are acknowledged within 24 hours and remediated or mitigated within 30 calendar days. Medium vulnerabilities are addressed within 90 days as part of standard release cadence. Emergency hotfix processes exist for out-of-cycle deployment when required; evidence of historical adherence can be provided on request"

Support notes:
- Historical ticket exports (anonymized) available: range 2024-07 -> 2025-06
- We run scheduled patch windows biweekly for infra components and continuous releases for runtime components where feasible.

If that wording is acceptable, I can produce the anonymized ticket export and a small timeline chart for inclusion.

—Karthik
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
